summary: BUG A FINAL FIX verified. Profile pill (`[data-testid=profile-scroll-top]`) now scrolls to the START of the STORICO VOTI section (target = historyYRef.current - 8) and the pill NEVER flickers back on during/after the animated glide, even though the final Y (890 px) is above the 700 px pill-visibility threshold. Verification flow: (i) token-injection login as chat_a@test.it via /api/auth/login + localStorage.setItem('faide_token', ...) [same pattern as iter 106]; (ii) navigate to /profile; (iii) expand STORICO VOTI accordion via `[data-testid=history-section-toggle]` — max scroll grew from ~616 to 1753 px; (iv) mouse-wheel scroll deep to scrollTop=1753 → pill parent opacity=1 confirmed; (v) tap `[data-testid=profile-scroll-top]`; (vi) sampled every 250ms for 3.5 s (14 samples): scrollTop transitioned 1753 → 983 (t+250ms) → 890 (t+500ms) and STAYED at 890 for the remaining 3000ms; (vii) pill parent opacity was 0 across ALL 14 samples (never flickered back on despite y>700); (viii) `document.querySelector('[data-testid=history-section]').offsetTop` = 898 → final scrollTop 890 = 898 - 8, EXACT match with the intended target; (ix) post-tap screenshot confirms the STORICO VOTI title, `Visibile a tutti` / `Visibile alla cerchia bilaterale` toggles and the first three history rows (Spider-Man, Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra, Travis Scott) are visible near the top of the ScrollView viewport (history-section top = 8 px from viewport top). Regression path (manual drag re-releases the lock) could NOT be fully exercised on desktop Playwright — see note below — but code review confirms the release path is wired correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Reiterating the code-hygiene note from iter 106: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx is now 1892 lines (was 1867 in iter 106) — >2.7× the 700-line guideline. Not a regression, but a good candidate for a future refactor into sub-components (Header, BadgeCard, Stats, StoricoVoti, Prefs, Photos).

Regression path (manual drag releases scrollLockRef) is theoretically sound via `onScrollBeginDrag={() => { scrollLockRef.current = false; }}` at line 837-846 of profile.tsx, but is NOT observable through desktop Playwright: mouse-wheel scrolling in RN Web does NOT fire `onScrollBeginDrag` (which is bound to native `touchstart`), and Playwright's `page.touchscreen` requires `hasTouch: true` on the browser context which is not enabled here. In our test the user scrolled back to 1753 via mouse-wheel and the pill stayed hidden — this is EXPECTED given RN Web's event mapping and is NOT a real-mobile bug. On a real touch device the finger drag fires touchstart → onScrollBeginDrag → releases the lock → subsequent onScroll setShowTopBtn(y>700) turns the pill back on. Recommend the main agent (or user) do one manual verification pass on a real device or Expo Go to confirm. Alternatively, if a web-only fallback is desired, the release could also be wired to a mouseDown / wheel listener on the ScrollView, but that would deviate from the archive.tsx pattern the comment claims to mirror.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the main flow (pill destination + no-flicker); regression path not observable in desktop Playwright (see critical_code_review_comments)

seed_data_creation: None. chat_a@test.it already has 9 STORICO VOTI entries — enough to push max-scroll to 1753 px once the accordion is expanded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse the token-injection login pattern for chat_a@test.it: `await page.goto('/'); await page.evaluate("async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({email:'chat_a@test.it', password:'test123'})}); const j = await r.json(); localStorage.setItem('faide_token', JSON.stringify(j.token)); }"); await page.goto('/profile')`. On /profile the STORICO VOTI accordion is COLLAPSED by default — click `[data-testid=history-section-toggle]` before scrolling, otherwise maxScroll stays ~616 (< 700 pill threshold). To find the target Y that the pill scrolls to, read `document.querySelector('[data-testid=history-section]').offsetTop` after expanding — pill target is `offsetTop - 8`. Pill visibility: read `getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid=profile-scroll-top]').parentElement).opacity`. The scrollable RNW element inside `[data-testid=profile-screen]` is not directly targetable by testID — find it programmatically via largest scrollHeight-clientHeight delta (see the marker snippet in the iter 107 script). IMPORTANT: mouse-wheel scrolling does NOT fire `onScrollBeginDrag` in RN Web (which is bound to touchstart), so the regression path 'manual drag releases scrollLockRef' cannot be reproduced via mouse.wheel or programmatic scrollTop — you'd need `hasTouch: true` in the Playwright context and real Touch events.
rca_of_issue: PRIOR ITERATION 106: onPress used scrollTo({y:0}) — worked (no flicker) but went TOO far up, past the STORICO VOTI header all the way to the avatar. CURRENT FIX (iter 107): onPress now scrolls to `Math.max(0, historyYRef.current - 8)` (STORICO VOTI section start). Because that target is itself > 700 px, the onScroll handler would flip showTopBtn back to `true` during the animated glide, making the pill flicker back on. RESOLUTION: (a) `scrollLockRef` set to `true` on pill tap; (b) `onScroll` short-circuits `setShowTopBtn` when the lock is held (line 858); (c) `onScrollBeginDrag` releases the lock (line 845), so the pill still legitimately re-appears when the user drags back down; (d) a 750 ms non-animated safety-net `scrollTo(target)` guarantees the final position is exact even if the animated glide undershoots. Test confirms scrollTop lands at exactly `historyYRef - 8` = 890 within 500 ms and stays there, pill opacity=0 for the full 3500 ms sampling window, and STORICO VOTI header + first 3 history rows are visible at viewport top. FIX IS WORKING AS INTENDED.
